description: This file declares the SiftUploader class, which manages uploading analytics events to a specified URL, including threading, retry logic, and event composition.

classes.name: SiftUploader
classes.description: Manages the process of uploading analytics events, including threading, retry policies, and JSON composition.

methods.name: setDeviceInfoRequiredFields
methods.description: Sets the device-related fields (accountId, deviceId, partnerId) required for event enrichment.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main thread function that manages the uploader's state machine and workflow.

methods.name: PerformWaitIfRetryNeeded
methods.description: Handles waiting logic between retries when necessary.

methods.name: RandomisationWindowTimeGenerator
methods.description: Generates a delay within the randomization window to stagger upload attempts.

methods.name: CollectEventsFromAnalyticsStore
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of events from the associated SiftStore.

methods.name: ComposeJSONEventArrayToBeUploaded
methods.description: Converts a list of event strings into a JSON array string for upload.

methods.name: updateEventDeviceInfoIfRequired
methods.description: Adds device info fields to an event JSON object if required.

methods.name: validateResponse
methods.description: Checks the server response for errors and validity.

methods.name: PostJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST with JSON data to the specified URL and retrieves the response.
